title: USF-201 local mock provider substrate proof and disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: Local mock provider substrate parity is split by semantic requirement. USF-201 proves bounded webhook-sink capture against local Compose using an adapter-contained protocol exception. LocalStack and WireMock remain explicit follow-up issues. USF-210 reclassifies historical mock OIDC service operation as superseded for the selected closure tier by hermetic identity and composed Keycloak proof evidence, without claiming mock OIDC service equivalence or live external provider compatibility.

mockProviderSubstrateDisposition.riskStatement: Local mock, fixture, webhook capture, or emulator evidence could be mistaken for live external provider compatibility, cloud-provider parity, notification delivery proof, or complete local mock substrate readiness.
mockProviderSubstrateDisposition.treatment: USF-201 proves bounded webhook-sink capture semantics with deterministic local Compose proof, no external egress, synthetic data, redaction, audit-shaped evidence, timeout and fail-closed unavailable handling, and teardown. LocalStack and WireMock service semantics remain deferred to USF-208 and USF-209. USF-210 records that historical mock OIDC service operation is superseded for the selected closure tier by existing hermetic identity and composed Keycloak proof evidence, while preserving non-equivalence and live-provider non-claims.
mockProviderSubstrateDisposition.deferredEvidence: USF-201 does not prove LocalStack cloud-emulator semantics, WireMock HTTP contract fixture semantics, notification delivery, provider callback/replay, live external provider compatibility, staging, production, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full React parity, or USF-133 closure. USF-210 does not prove mock OIDC service startup, issuer compatibility as a standalone service, live IdP compatibility, SSO readiness, or production identity-provider readiness.

mockSubstrateClassifications.nonEquivalenceBoundary: LocalStack emulation is not live cloud-provider operation, supplier evidence, credential posture, tenant isolation proof, no-egress proof, or production cloud compatibility.
WireMock fixtures prove configured mock behaviour only after proof exists; they are not live external provider compatibility, provider contract certification, or production provider readiness.
Webhook sink capture proof is not notification delivery, provider feedback ingestion, deliverability, live webhook compatibility, external provider proof, or full local mock substrate readiness.

USF-210 classifies historical mock OIDC service operation as superseded for the selected closure tier only. Hermetic identity proof and composed Keycloak proof are not proof of the historical mock OIDC service, live IdP compatibility, SSO provider readiness, or production identity-provider readiness.

hermeticMockSubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Hermetic mock providers, provider registry proof, and local fixture evidence are not equivalent to LocalStack service semantics, WireMock HTTP contract semantics, webhook sink delivery or capture proof, mock OIDC service operation, live external provider compatibility, supplier approval, no-egress proof, or production provider readiness.

Configured fixture posture is not WireMock runtime proof, external provider contract compatibility, or live provider evidence.
